pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-polygonal dark regions with smoothed edge gradients. Patch area is larger in the cervical region and decreases in relative pixel-scale toward the posterior-dorsal transition near the shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored negative space forming a continuous topological grid. Junction nodes are primarily tri-directional, with pathways maintaining a relatively uniform pixel-width across the visible lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour visible along the superior neck boundary, corresponding to the mane silhouette against the background.
